ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious File Download From ZIP TLD
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the download of a file with a potentially suspicious extension from a .zip top level domain. Note: Unmapped fields: Contents

sequences.query: (Contents = RGX(".*\\\.zip\\/.*") AND (file_path = RGX(".*\\\.bat\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.dat\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.dll\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.doc\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.docm\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.hta\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.pptm\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.ps1\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.rar\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.rtf\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.sct\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.vbe\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.vbs\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.ws\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.wsf\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.xll\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.xls\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.xlsm\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.zip\\:Zone.*")))
